packet_digest.description: Copy verbatim from the current role packet. Ingestion verifies this digest against the packet bytes and freeze metadata.

reviewed_sections.description: Copy verbatim from the review packet. Maps each campaign section this role is responsible for to its digest at review time, so a later repair elsewhere in the campaign does not invalidate this review. Omit only for legacy records, which fall back to whole-campaign content_digest matching.

execution_evidence.description: Required when mode is independent-subagent, separate-session, or external-human. Self-attested: it records who ran the review and when so the claim is auditable. Nothing in this skill can observe another process and prove independence.

executor_id.description: Distinct process, session, or person identifier; must differ per reviewer at high-assurance.

findings.description: Return at most the three highest-priority findings. If more material findings exist, use verdict block and disclose their total count and highest severity in summary.
